Keep the top 35% plain, calm deep Partner Navy sky with no detail, because it sits under a navy scrim and the end of the hero text; the ribbon, the hills and the swallows sit in the lower two thirds. Portrait 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
